layout.hierarchy: Title largest and boldest in dark red; row labels 'Classification'/'Regression' in blue italic bold; panel captions in black bold; parenthetical sub-captions smaller black; plots are the dominant visual mass.

visual_elements.description: Three scatter plots in a row, each with x/y axes (unlabeled ticks), red 'X' markers clustered lower-left and gray 'O' markers upper-right, with a blue decision-boundary curve. Panel 1 'Under-fitting': straight diagonal blue line separating classes, caption below '(too simple to explain the variance)'. Panel 2 'Appropriate-fitting': smooth gently curved blue boundary. Panel 3 'Over-fitting': highly wiggly blue boundary looping around individual points, caption '(forcefitting -- too good to be true)'.

Left regression plot: light green background, axes labeled y (vertical) and x (horizontal); black circle data points along a curve; legend top-right: 'Data' (circle marker), 'Target' (thin line), 'Fit' (line); a smooth target curve and a smooth fit curve (blue/dark) that deviates at the right end (underfit).

Right regression plot: light green background, axes y and x; black circle data points; legend bottom-right: 'Data', '2nd Order Fit' (smooth green curve), '10th Order Fit' (red wiggly curve passing through every point, oscillating wildly at edges).
Red rectangular borders around the classification panel group, each regression panel, and the whole slide.

imagery: No photographs; all visuals are hand-drawn-style schematic plots with markers and curves.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title large bold dark red. Row labels ('Classification', 'Regression') blue bold italic. Panel captions bold black; sub-captions smaller regular black in parentheses. Legends small sans-serif.
animation_state: Fully built; no partial reveal evident.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background light gray (#F2F2F2) and draw a thin dark-red (#AA0000) border rectangle around the entire slide edge. 2. Add title 'Data Overfit and Underfit' centered near top, bold, dark red (#B00000), large sans-serif. 3. Add a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with '19' at top-right. 4. Draw a large red-bordered box occupying the middle. Inside, left side: blue bold-italic label 'Classification' aligned to the upper row. 5. In the upper row place three equal scatter-plot panels side by side: each with plain axes, red X markers lower-left, gray O markers upper-right. Panel 1: straight diagonal blue line; caption 'Under-fitting' bold, then '(too simple to explain the variance)'. Panel 2: smooth curved blue boundary; caption 'Appropriate-fitting'. Panel 3: wiggly blue boundary looping around points; caption 'Over-fitting', then '(forcefitting -- too good to be true)'. 6. Lower row: blue bold-italic label 'Regression' at left. 7. Add two light-green (#CCFFCC) red-bordered plot panels: left panel with data circles, smooth 'Target' curve and 'Fit' curve, legend top-right (Data/Target/Fit), axes labeled y and x; right panel with data circles, smooth green '2nd Order Fit' and red oscillating '10th Order Fit' passing through all points, legend bottom-right (Data/2nd Order Fit/10th Order Fit), axes y and x.
